system: PGIA Postgraduate Academic Lifecycle State Machine & Decision Graph
institution: Postgraduate Institute of Agriculture, University of Peradeniya

Masters_CW.name: Master of Science (Course Work)
Masters_CW.breakdown: 25 Credits Coursework + 5 Credits Directed Study / Project

MSc_CWR.name: Master of Science (Course Work & Research)
research_milestones: Full proposal presentation and ethical clearance
Biannual progress reports every 6 months (S/U grade)
Minimum 1 research paper submitted to refereed journal
Final green hardbound thesis submission (2 copies + PDF CD within 3 months)

MBA_CWR.name: Master of Business Administration (Course Work & Research)

MPhil.name: Master of Philosophy
MPhil.publication_requirement: 1 published paper + 1 submitted paper in refereed journal
MPhil.upgrade_route: Eligible to upgrade to Ph.D. after minimum 1 year with Board approval

PhD.name: Doctor of Philosophy
PhD.nature: Pure Research Degree (Split PhD option with foreign universities)
PhD.fallback_exit: May be awarded M.Phil. if doctoral defense does not pass but MPhil criteria met

INQUIRY.description: Prospective applicant exploring degree programs, entry requirements, and deadlines.

APPLICATION_SUBMITTED.description: Application form submitted with certified degree certificates, birth certificate, referee reports, and paying voucher.

ENROLLED_COURSEWORK.description: Active coursework student registered in MIS, attending lectures, and submitting modular assessments.
regulations: Course enrolment in MIS during first 2 weeks
Maximum 4 credits outside Board of Study
Grades below B can be retaken to improve GPA

COMPREHENSIVE_EXAM_PREP.description: Student has completed coursework credits and prepares to sit for Comprehensive Examination.
prerequisites: All coursework credits completed (30 for MSc, 36 for MBA)
COMPREHENSIVE_EXAM_PREP.attempt_rules: Maximum 2 attempts permitted. Failure at 2nd attempt leads to PGD exit award if eligible.

RESEARCH_PROPOSAL_INITIATION.description: Initiation of research degree or research component.
steps: Submit concept note and draft proposal
Interim supervisor appointed by Board of Study
Develop full research proposal within 3 months
Defend proposal before Board of Study
Obtain Ethical Clearance from PGIA Ethical Review Committee

CANDIDACY_RESEARCH_ACTIVE.description: Active research conduction, field/laboratory experiments, and data analysis.
requirements: Submit progress report every 6 months to PGIA (Form PR-1) with supervisor S/U grading
Present research findings at PGIA Annual Congress
Prepare and submit manuscripts to peer-reviewed indexed journals

THESIS_PRE_SUBMISSION.description: Research completed; student prepares for thesis examination.
prerequisites: All course and research credits fulfilled
All biannual progress reports submitted and graded Satisfactory
Required journal papers published or submitted
Spiral bound copies (2 for MSc/MPhil, 3 for PhD) signed by all supervisors

THESIS_DEFENSE.description: Oral viva voce examination conducted by Examination Committee with internal and external examiners.
possible_outcomes: Accepted as submitted (Effective date = Date of Defense)
Accepted subject to minor revisions (Must submit final copies within 3 months; effective date = Date of Defense)
Accepted subject to major revisions (Must re-submit for repeat defense between 6 and 12 months)

steps: Submit 2 green hardbound copies with gold lettering + PDF soft copy
Student ID card invalidated by library
Degree awarded at University of Peradeniya General Convocation
